baseline.observedPage: The previous live page described any JSON, production-ready types and unconditional privacy. It did not explain sample-based uncertainty, missing versus null, JSON Lines, nested selection or inference bounds.

research.existingEvidence: docs/tools-keywords-2026-09-28.json contains two successful autocomplete seeds for this tool, with source URLs and timestamps.

freshAutocomplete.method: Eight Google autocomplete requests on 2026-10-05 using client=firefox, hl=en and gl=us. Three completed; five timed out. Empty suggestions are not evidence of no demand.

competitors.observation: Advertises JSON/JSON Schema/GraphQL input, runtime validation and CLI workflows. Product scope observed, not benchmarked. ByteVerse does not claim those capabilities.
Advertises interface/type output, nested types and readonly options. These options alone are not unique differentiation.

research.limitations: No new authenticated Search Console report, measured search volume, keyword difficulty, ranking diagnosis or traffic forecast.

sources.supports: Unions, interface/type distinctions, optional properties and compile-time versus runtime behavior.
Object properties, index signatures, readonly properties and ReadonlyArray; readonly is not runtime freezing.
UTF-8, one valid JSON value per line, no blank samples or BOM, optional final newline.
Explicit pointers, ~1 and ~0 escapes, empty-key distinction and canonical array indices.

implementation.core: Strict token/AST parsing using the already installed jsonc-parser 3.3.1; no new dependency for this tool. All selected observations contribute to merged object shapes, missing-field optionality and mixed/null unions. Numeric tokens yield number types without using the parser's rounded numeric values.
implementation.selection: Keep the selected value or infer direct array items; optional RFC 6901 pointer must resolve in every JSONL sample. JSONL lines are repeated root observations, not an implicit output array.
implementation.generation: Interface/type styles, stable location-based collision-safe declaration names, escaped unusual keys, recursive readonly, all-optional override, bounded string literals, sorting, indentation and export controls. Non-object roots use a type alias; disabled exports retain an export {} module guard.
implementation.workspace: Responsive light/dark editor, four fictional examples, field-presence table with 25/50-field pagination, complete and individual-declaration previews, UTF-8 file import with inspected replacement confirmation, clear confirmation, cancellable worker, stale-result invalidation and full-copy/download.
implementation.exports: Complete UTF-8 .ts or .d.ts output, including all nested declarations and module guard, even when previewing one declaration. Windows device filenames receive a safe suffix. Clipboard fallback selects full code; delayed writes warn when the result changed.
implementation.bounds: 1,000,000 input UTF-16 characters, 2 MiB UTF-8, depth40, 200k tokens/nodes, 10k samples/selected values, 200 declarations, 2k generated properties, 1024-character keys, 4096-character pointers, 400k output characters, 15-second worker deadline. Limits reject rather than truncate.
implementation.privacy: Conversion uses a local worker, no conversion upload/AI/storage path. Global ads and analytics are separate; the whole page is not claimed to be an isolated environment. Keys always appear in output; optional string literals include source values.
implementation.limitations: Sample-based drafts, not runtime validation or a complete API contract. No tagged-union correlation, tuple, class, Date, bigint, JSON Schema or validator generation. No browser TypeScript compiler or URL import.

seo.title: Free JSON to TypeScript Converter - Interfaces & Types

harnessCorrections: V8 can replace a throwing VM global getter error with ReferenceError; tests assert the deny trap was invoked as well as rejection.

Next16.2.6 Turbopack transforms the source module Worker into its same-origin classic bootstrap. The browser test now verifies that exact bootstrap and chunk paths, not an incorrect required module constructor option.
Explicitly held worker tests capture only the test watchdog to prevent wall-clock expiry while exercising delayed delivery.
Edge may repeat test initialization during native downloads; the instrumentation is idempotent and keeps the original observations.
The synthetic multi-megabyte paste gets a45s test action timeout; product size limits and15s generation deadline are unchanged.
